parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description:
Format: **field_name_1,field_name_2[DIRECTION_2]
    Refer to the filter section at the top of the page for more details.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
Format: field[COMPARATOR]:value,field2[COMPARATOR]:value2.
    For like/ilike, use % as a wildcard (e.g. %value% for substring match).
    Refer to the filter section at the top of the page for more details.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limits the number of objects returned.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description:
Determines the level of nested related objects to include in the response.
    - 0: Primary object only
    - 1: Primary object + direct relations

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Returns objects starting after a specific cursor. You can find cursors in **startCursor** and **endCursor** in **pageInfo** in response data

parameters.name: ending_before
parameters.description: Returns objects ending before a specific cursor. You can find cursors in **startCursor** and **endCursor** in **pageInfo** in response data
